game_start.intro: Papadi e simolola. Suti ya trump: {trump_suit} (kadi ya trump: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
O pelenyana {player_id} mo German Whist.
{phase_info}
O na le {hand_size} dikadi.
Tshameka kadi le '[play N]', moo N ke poso ya yona mo mmong wa gago (ka moforo '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Ga go na karata epe e re ka kgonang go e bona - motshameko o simolotse.
next_card.deck_empty: Go se na sepe mo teng ga mokgoro - go ka se nne le karata epe.
next_card.available: Karata e o ka kgonang go nna le yone: {card}
next_card.available_trump: Karata e go buisanwang ka yone: {card} (TRUMP)

invalid_move.wrong_format: Go dirisa '[play N]' go tshameka karata ya Nth mo seatleng sa gago.
invalid_move.bad_position: Karata eo ga e yo. O tshwere dikarata tsa {hand_size} .
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: O tshwanetse go dira se a se dirileng mme o tshameke karata ya {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: O ka se kgone go dira jalo.

trick.won_learning: Pelenyana {winner_id} a fenya kgetho le {card} a tsaya kadi e emeng e ntle

phase.learning_complete: Go setse go fedile ka mokgobo ono. Kgato ya go ithuta e fetile - leano lengwe le lengwe la boferefere le a thusa gore o fenye.

draw.winner_received: O fentse motshameko mme o amogetse {card}.
draw.loser_received: O ne wa latlhegelwa ke motshameko mme o bo o ntsha {card} mo teng ga deck.

turn.scores_learning: Dikgetho tse di fitileng - Pelenyana 0: {tricks0}, Pelenyana 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Pego: {phase} ({remaining_cards} dikadi di sala mo deck)
